scenario.task:
I want to upgrade my mobile plan to a higher tier with more high-speed data

User Guide: The user wants more data for their phone. They will provide their phone number, verify their identity, listen to the 2-3 plan options, select the best one, and confirm the upgrade If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
